name: Indian Shrimp Curry with Tomatoes, Kale & Cilantro over Rice (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, small dice tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
When the onion is softened, add ginger, garlic, spices, and sugar to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp curry powder
2 tsp garam masala
2 tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
2 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Add diced tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth to the pot, then stir to combine the curry. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
380 ml coconut milk
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the curry has thickened, add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (283 g) bag kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Add cilantro and shrimp to the pot, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Divide rice and curry between the containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Heat in a microwave or saucepan and enjoy!
